query: The deploy's composer install 404s on our private netdust/ntdst-core package over the SSH deploy key. Should I add --prefer-source to the post_deploy_hooks?
signature: says no to the global flag — it clones EVERY package (WordPress core, dev tools) and fills the server; answers with a per-package map in composer.json, "preferred-install": {"netdust/*": "source", "*": "dist"}, and a hook of `composer install --no-dev` carrying no --prefer-* flag, because a command-line flag overrides the map

query: Is there a quick way to see whether one of our servers is running out of disk?
signature: answers `make health` — its Disk section reports each server's use once per host and flags FULL at 80% — and names the usual suspects (the composer cache, /var/log/journal, old backups) rather than proposing an ad-hoc monitoring script
